text_block_list.name: Underclassman Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—So it was her... who came to us seeking 
advice.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
From the looks of things... reinforcing 
her stamina is an urgent priority. 
Especially since her own goal is to win 
long-distance races.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah. And also, improving... pace 
distribution. As stamina 
increases—learning how to utilize it is 
necessary.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
And also—a flexible strategy. The state of 
battle is...—different in every race. To 
match that... the pace distribution 
changes too.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. As expected of Kris S-san. To 
identify that many issues after just a 
brief observation...

text_block_list.name: Underclassman Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...Haa, haa. I-I'm completely exhausted 
after all... My run... was completely 
hopeless, wasn't it...?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Don't get too pessimistic. That's where 
your thinking will grind to a halt.

text_block_list.name: Underclassman Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Now, regarding our training objectives: 
first and foremost is building stamina. 
That is more important than anything.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
After that, let's learn about pace 
distribution and tactical patterns too.

text_block_list.name: Underclassman Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, so many things I did wrong... I 
wonder if I can really do this...

text_block_list.name: Underclassman Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Ah, um... I-I'm sorry! I'll stop 
whining and do my best...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...It's all right, don't try to take it 
all on yourself. You have us by your side.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
You wanted to clear a path forward... 
That's why you came to talk to me, right?

text_block_list.name: Underclassman Umamusume
text_block_list.text: T-That's right...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Then I want to help you so you can feel 
proud and believe that doing so was the 
right choice. ...Please, let us support 
you.

text_block_list.name: Underclassman Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Hk, yes! Once again, I look forward to 
working with you!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, likewise. Let us join hands, the 
three of us, and move forward together.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I'll explain how to improve on 
your challenges. First, regarding your 
stamina—

Later on, while having lunch with Cesario 
and the others—

text_block_list.name: Underclassman Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Senpa~i! Thanks to you, I won the race!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I see...! Good for you. Though the one who 
deserves the most credit is you, for 
turning that advice into strength.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
And don't grow complacent or let your 
guard down here. If you ever need 
anything, you're always welcome to come 
back.

text_block_list.name: Underclassman Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Okaaay! Thank you so, so much!!

After the underclassman left, I heard that 
Cesario and the others had been giving her 
advice. It seems their cooperation bore 
fruit.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It's all because she worked so hard. And 
thanks to Kris S-san's knowledge as well, 
I'm sure.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
No. The reason we won...—Cesario. It was 
thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Huh? As for the concrete improvement 
regimen, Kris S-san proposed most of—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...You made her relax. That's why she 
accepted your advice—so willingly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
That, too... is an important quality. 
...—As a leader.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
So, in your wake... People will—surely 
follow. So——... you are the 'Foundation.'

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Kris S-san—

As someone aspiring to be a coach, earning 
Symboli Kris S's acknowledgment must be a 
huge boost to her confidence.
choice_data_list:
It's reassuring to have such a dependable 
senior around.

It's reassuring to have such a dependable 
senior around, isn't it?
That was a great experience, wasn't it!

text_block_list.text:
As someone aspiring to be a coach, earning 
Symboli Kris S's acknowledgment must be a 
huge boost to her confidence.
choice_data_list:
It's reassuring to have such a dependable 
senior around.

It's reassuring to have such a dependable 
senior around, isn't it?
That was a great experience, wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes, very much so. I'm learning a great 
deal from it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Me too... You have... what I don't. 
You... possess it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Therefore――What an incredible junior...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'll keep deepening my studies so 
you'll continue saying that to me in the 
future.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If there are other juniors in 
trouble, I want to reach out and lend them 
a hand like this.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: May I... join you? I want to—help you.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Together, I know we can guide 
them just like we did today.
choice_data_list:
Looks like we can gain all sorts of 
experience, huh

Looks like we can gain all sorts of 
experience, huh

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'll do my best so I can become a 
great coach someday!
